kind: Prospectively specified generated comparison; no bank identity validation
question: Does an explicit bound on corrupted records preserve causal uncertainty when forced joins fail?
population: n=1000, X uniform[-1,1], A Bernoulli(.5), epsilon uniform[-1,1]; Y=100+30A+10X+20epsilon. ATE30. Analyst is given global outcome support [70,160].
identity: 200 generated six-letter names and 365 birth-day categories. These are artificial collisions, not a calibrated bank-record process. Independent random row IDs and shuffled table order. No true cross-table ID in analysis inputs.
corruption: Exactly K=round(n*rate) outcome records chosen without replacement. Weights 1 (independent), 1+.8X (covariate dependent), or .2+1.6*(Y-70)/90 (outcome dependent). Cycle four corruptions: blank name; one-character name edit; copy another person's name/date; add conflicting duplicate with support-bounded outcome. Original outcome is retained for duplicates. No analyst receives selected records or corruption types.
comparators: Evaluator truth contrast with normal interval
Exact unique join, with duplicate proposal abstention
Fuzzy unique join allowing one character difference with same date; missing names use date candidates; ambiguous joins abstain
Candidate outcome range or global support when no candidate; conditional on true candidate inclusion
Candidate bounds enlarged for at most K exclusions, plus a simultaneous Hoeffding sampling envelope
bounds: For each unit, min/max candidate outcomes or [70,160] form contribution bounds w_i*Y_i, w=1/n1 or -1/n0. Lower bound is reduced by the K largest possible downward support corrections; upper bound increased by K largest upward corrections. This is conservative, not sharp: one-to-one constraints are relaxed. K bounds exclusions, is supplied as a design sensitivity input, and is not estimated from match confidence.
sampling: Each group has outcome range at most90. Add +/-90*(sqrt(log(80)/(2*n1))+sqrt(log(80)/(2*n0))) by union-bound Hoeffding for 95% coverage of the population effect. Normal complete-case intervals have no selection correction.
metrics: Coverage of full-data realised contrast by conditional and corruption-aware sets
review: Truth never enters the matcher. Outcome is used only by the evaluator's corruption mechanism. Duplicate matches are refused. Candidate-set inclusion is evaluated, never assumed from a score. The known corruption count is a sensitivity assumption; an actual application needs audit evidence for its budget and valid outcome support. No tuned fuzzy score or novel matching algorithm claimed.
criteria: Prove realised-contrast enclosure under the specified exclusion budget; validate it on every draw and by a small exhaustive bound check. Report empirical population coverage with Monte Carlo uncertainty. No method ranking from match accuracy alone.
stop: Stop affected study for truth leakage, corrupt exports, nonfinite estimates, violated support or bounds excluding the realised contrast with a correct exclusion budget. Continue other programme work.
not_concluded: No bank linkage accuracy, universal partial identification, commercial deployment, or optimal matching method. Wide defensible bounds may prevent any spending decision.
